# hue_zone (Resource)

Manage a Hue zone. Deleting this resource deletes the group from the bridge.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hue_light" "desk" {
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}

resource "hue_zone" "work" {
  name     = "Work"
  children = [data.hue_light.desk.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `children` (Set of String) Set of light UUIDs.
- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `archetype` (String) Hue group archetype. Defaults to other.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Bridge resource UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hue_zone.work 55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555
```
